aboutText: Based in Coburg North, Period Wardrobes Melbourne specialises in crafting custom wardrobes and storage solutions for heritage and contemporary homes across Melbourne. Our team has years of experience designing and building pieces that honour the character of Victorian, Edwardian/Federation, Californian Bungalow, and Art Deco properties. We combine traditional craftsmanship with modern functionality to deliver wardrobes, shoe storage, bookshelves, and work stations that fit your space and style perfectly.
servicesText: From heritage-accurate Victorian wardrobes to contemporary built-ins, we design and build custom storage solutions tailored to your Coburg North home and lifestyle.

services.title: Victorian Wardrobes

services.title: Californian Bungalow Storage

services.title: Art Deco Wardrobes
